mapper.sql: attachment_id, bom_master_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, description, upload_by, upload_time
mapper.select: select from bom_drawing_attachment where bom_master_id = #{bomMasterId} order by upload_time desc, attachment_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into bom_drawing_attachment( bom_master_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, description, upload_by, upload_time ) values ( #{bomMasterId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt}, #{mimeType}, #{description}, #{uploadBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from bom_drawing_attachment where bom_master_id = #{bomMasterId} and attachment_id = #{attachmentId}
